title: Open-Meteo historical archive – Hong Kong grid point, 17-25 January 2026
claims: The returned grid point is at latitude 22.3902 and longitude 114.2236, at an elevation of 380 m, with timezone Asia/Hong_Kong.
Daily maximum temperatures from 17 to 25 January 2026 ranged from 13.9°C to 23.4°C, with a median of 18.2°C.
Daily minimum temperatures over the same nine days ranged from 6.5°C to 12.8°C, with a median of 10.3°C.
Only one of the nine days recorded any precipitation, 0.1 mm on 23 January 2026; no day reached 1 mm.
On 24 January 2026 the modelled daily maximum was 18.0°C and the minimum 7.2°C, with no precipitation.
These values are grid-point modelled historical data, not on-course measurements.
